From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15m guided onramp after your usage surge

Hi Jamie,

Congrats — I noticed BrightMetrics ramped a lot of activity on the self-serve plan over the last 48 hours. If you’ve got 15 minutes, we can run a quick guided onramp to:  
- walk through the token/latency profile we saw,
- show one or two prompt tweaks that reduce cost by ~15%, and
- point to the simplest config for predictable throughput.

I attached a short CSV with the spike (usage-report-20290717.csv) and our 1-page onramp checklist. If you prefer, pick any 15-min slot here: https://calendar.redwood.com/slot/GRACE-15m.

Quick options I have today (PDT):
- 3:30–3:45pm
- 4:15–4:30pm

Otherwise tell me a window that works and I’ll loop in Priyom (SDR) to send a calendar invite. We keep these focused and technical — totally fine to have an engineer join.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
SDR, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
